evidence_quote: full potential of industrial heat treatments

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Project overview of the Fraunhofer HTL 'EnerTHERM' ceramic heat-treatment research programme: develops in-situ measuring devices (TOM family), a kinetic-field technique predicting sintering shrinkage, and furnace-investigation methods, and demonstrates energy/throughput optimization of alumina sintering. Energy management (ISO 50001) is cited only as motivation; no EnPI/EnB measurement model is presented or characterised (energy consumption is directly measured with current clamps, not modelled or normalised into an indicator/baseline).

paper_type.evidence_quote: four different TOM devices are designed

stage1.notes: Fraunhofer HTL 'EnerTHERM' project overview (ceramic heat treatment). Builds TOM measuring devices + kinetic-field sintering-shrinkage model + furnace methods; demos alumina-sintering energy/throughput optimization (energy vs holding temperature, measured by current clamps). ISO 50001 cited only as motivation; no EnPI/EnB model characterised. paper_type tool/software-design vs other is borderline. Application is batch/ceramics (not a continuous-process sector), so 3B false regardless.
